movies.overview: The true story of Henry Hill, a half-Irish, half-Sicilian Brooklyn kid who is adopted by neighbourhood gangsters at an early age and climbs the ranks of a Mafia family under the guidance of Jimmy Conway.
movies.title: GoodFellas
movies.tagline: Three decades of life in the mafia.

movies.overview: Wounded Civil War soldier John Dunbar tries to commit suicide—and becomes a hero instead. As a reward, he's assigned to his dream post, a remote junction on the Western frontier, and soon makes unlikely friends with the local Sioux tribe.
movies.title: Dances with Wolves
movies.tagline: Inside everyone is a frontier waiting to be discovered.

movies.overview: Wealthy Sunny von Bülow lies brain-dead, husband Claus guilty of attempted murder; but he says he's innocent and hires Alan Dershowitz for his appeal.
movies.title: Reversal of Fortune
movies.tagline: The Case of Claus Von Bulow. An American Saga of Money and Mystery.

movies.overview: A Polish-Jewish family comes to the U.S. at the beginning of the twentieth century. There, the family and their children try to make themselves a better future in the so-called promised land.
movies.title: Avalon
movies.tagline: Three generations of family. They shared a dream called America in a place called Avalon.

movies.overview: In the midst of trying to legitimize his business dealings in 1979 New York and Italy, aging mafia don, Michael Corleone seeks forgiveness for his sins while taking a young protege under his wing.
movies.title: The Godfather Part III
movies.tagline: All the power on earth can't change destiny.

movies.overview: Set in 1929, a political boss and his advisor have a parting of the ways when they both fall for the same woman.
movies.title: Miller's Crossing

movies.overview: A small suburban town receives a visit from a castaway unfinished science experiment named Edward.
movies.title: Edward Scissorhands
movies.tagline: Innocence is what he knows. Beauty is what she sees.

movies.overview: Rusty Sabich is a deputy prosecutor engaged in an obsessive affair with a coworker who is murdered. Soon after, he's accused of the crime. And his fight to clear his name becomes a whirlpool of lies and hidden passions.
movies.title: Presumed Innocent
movies.tagline: Some people would kill for love

movies.overview: A small-time conman has his loyalties torn between his estranged mother and his new girlfriend, both of whom are high-stakes grifters with their own angles to play.
movies.title: The Grifters
movies.tagline: Seduction. Betrayal. Murder. Who’s conning who?

movies.overview: A filmmaker recalls his childhood, when he fell in love with the movies at his village's theater and formed a deep friendship with the theater's projectionist.
movies.title: Cinema Paradiso
movies.tagline: An enchanted village. A wonderful friendship. Star-crossed lovers. And the magic of the movies.

movies.overview: Famed swordsman and poet Cyrano de Bergerac is in love with his cousin Roxane. He has never expressed his love for her as he his large nose undermines his self-confidence. Then he finds a way to express his love to her, indirectly.
movies.title: Cyrano de Bergerac

movies.overview: Dr. Malcolm Sayer, a shy research physician, uses an experimental drug to "awaken" the catatonic victims of a rare disease. Leonard is the first patient to receive the controversial treatment. His awakening, filled with awe and enthusiasm, proves a rebirth for Sayer too, as the exuberant patient reveals life's simple but unutterably sweet pleasures to the introverted doctor.
movies.title: Awakenings
movies.tagline: There is no such thing as a simple miracle.

movies.overview: A radical student is adopted by a group of young New Yorkers, serves as a catalyst to alter his and their lives. Gathering in a Manhattan apartment, the group of friends meet to discuss social mobility, Fourier's socialism and play bridge in their cocoon of upper-class society - until they are joined by a man with a critical view of their way of life.
movies.title: Metropolitan
movies.tagline: Finally... A film about the downwardly mobile.

movies.overview: An enigmatic drifter from the South comes to visit an old acquaintance who now lives in South-Central LA.
movies.title: To Sleep with Anger
movies.tagline: When Harry comes to town, he brings good times, bad times… And a lot of trouble!

movies.original_title: The Cook, the Thief, His Wife & Her Lover
movies.overview: The wife of an abusive criminal finds solace in the arms of a kind regular guest in her husband's restaurant.
movies.title: The Cook, the Thief, His Wife & Her Lover
movies.tagline: Lust...Murder...Dessert. Bon Appetit!

movies.overview: After a film student gets his belongings stolen, he meets a mobster bearing a startling resemblance to a certain cinematic godfather. Soon, he finds himself caught up in a caper involving endangered species and fine dining.
movies.title: The Freshman
movies.tagline: He was on his way to the Dean's List, but he wound up on the hit list.

movies.overview: When a young woman investigates her town's Nazi past, the community turns against her.
movies.title: The Nasty Girl

movies.original_title: Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer
movies.overview: Arriving in Chicago, Henry moves in with ex-con acquaintance Otis and starts schooling him in the ways of the serial killer.
movies.title: Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer
movies.tagline: He's not Freddy, he's not Jason...he's real.

movies.overview: During the summer of 1981, a group of friends in New York are completely unprepared for the onslaught of AIDS. What starts as a rumor about a mysterious "gay cancer" soon turns into a major crisis as, one by one, some of the friends begin to fall ill, leaving the others to panic about who will be next. As death takes its toll, the lives of these friends are forever redefined by an unconditional display of love, hope and courage.
movies.title: Longtime Companion
movies.tagline: …a motion picture for everyone

movies.overview: The buttoned-down, superstitious Kay is attempting to lead a normal existence with her new boyfriend Louis. That’s until Sweetie, her rampaging, devil-may-care sister, returns home after an absence, exposing the rotten roots of their family and placing a strain on Kay and Louis’ relationship.
movies.title: Sweetie
movies.tagline: There will not be a more extraordinary film than “Sweetie” in a long long time!

movies.overview: Young lovers Sailor and Lula hit the road to start a new life together away from the wrath of Lula’s deranged, disapproving mother, who has hired a team of hitmen to cut the lovers’ surreal honeymoon short.
movies.title: Wild at Heart
movies.tagline: A wild and crazy love story.

movies.overview: In 1920, Major Dellaplane, a man of honor and ethics, searches for missing French soldiers. He meets Madame Irène de Courtil, a politically connected Parisian, and their paths cross.
movies.title: Life and Nothing But

movies.overview: A group of actors putting on an interpretive Passion Play in Montreal begin to experience a meshing of their characters and their private lives as the production takes form against the growing opposition of the Catholic church.
movies.title: Jesus of Montreal

movies.overview: A French man spies on a lovely younger woman across the way. When he's spotted by the woman shortly after being questioned by the police about a local murder, the man's simple life becomes more complicated.
movies.title: Monsieur Hire

movies.overview: After a young man is murdered, his spirit stays behind to warn his lover of impending danger, with the help of a reluctant psychic.
movies.title: Ghost
movies.tagline: Before Sam was murdered, he told Molly he'd love and protect her forever.

movies.overview: A substance-addicted actress tries to look on the bright side even as she's forced to move back in with her mother to avoid unemployment.
movies.title: Postcards from the Edge
movies.tagline: Having a wonderful time, wish I were here.

movies.overview: The tragic story of Vincent van Gogh broadened by focusing as well on his brother Theodore, who helped support Vincent. Based on the letters written between the two.
movies.title: Vincent & Theo
movies.tagline: An obsessive vision. A desperate dream. A world that didn't understand… And a brother that did.

movies.overview: Set during World War II, an upper-class family begins to fall apart due to the conservative nature of the patriarch and the progressive values of his children.
movies.title: Mr. & Mrs. Bridge
movies.tagline: Divided by time and tradition. United by love and hope. The story of an unforgettable family.

movies.overview: While traveling in Paris, author Henry Miller and his wife, June, meet Anais Nin, and sexual sparks fly as Nin starts an affair with the openly bisexual June. When June is forced to return to the U.S., she gives Nin her blessing to sleep with her husband. Then, when June returns to France, an unexpected, and sometimes contentious, threesome forms.
movies.title: Henry & June
movies.tagline: A true adventure more erotic than any fantasy

movies.overview: The comic strip detective finds his life vastly complicated when Breathless Mahoney makes advances towards him while he is trying to battle Big Boy Caprice's united mob.
movies.title: Dick Tracy
movies.tagline: Their turf. Their game. Their rules. They didn't count on HIS law...

movies.overview: While on a business trip in Los Angeles, Edward Lewis, a millionaire entrepreneur who makes a living buying and breaking up companies, picks up a prostitute, Vivian, while asking for directions; after, Edward hires Vivian to stay with him for the weekend to accompany him to a few social events, and the two get closer only to discover there are significant hurdles to overcome as they try to bridge the gap between their very different worlds.
movies.title: Pretty Woman
movies.tagline: She walked off the street, into his life and stole his heart.

movies.overview: Twins Ronnie and Reggie Kray are raised in east London, under the influence of their hateful but doting mother Violet. As they grow up, Ronnie's violent nature takes over, and Reggie follows his brother's lead. The two become notorious crime lords who rule over the East End club scene. But at the height of their power, the brothers veer into different lives, giving the older crime bosses a chance to reclaim what the Krays took from them.
movies.title: The Krays
movies.tagline: When people are afraid of you... you can do anything. Remember that.

movies.overview: A widowed mother and her two sons move to Baltimore and struggle to adjust to urban life, encountering numerous eccentric characters along the way.
movies.title: Men Don't Leave
movies.tagline: A comedy about the drama of life.

movies.overview: Eight visually rich vignettes drawn from Kurosawa’s own dreams—fox weddings and vanished orchards, a soldier’s ghosts, a walk through Van Gogh’s canvases, nuclear nightmares, and a water-mill utopia—meditate on childhood, art, mortality, and humanity’s uneasy bond with nature.
movies.title: Dreams
movies.tagline: The past, present, and future. The thoughts and images of one man... for all men. One man's dreams... for every dreamer.

movies.overview: After Junior is released from prison, he plans on starting a new life in Miami. But when he kills a man in the airport, he flees the scene and finds Susie, a mild-mannered prostitute searching for stability. The two opposites become romantically involved, and Junior steals a badge and gun from a veteran detective. Using the officer's identity, Junior embarks on a crime spree and convinces Susie that he is the perfect man.
movies.title: Miami Blues
movies.tagline: Real badge. Real gun. Fake cop.

movies.overview: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub, the Red October, is heading for the U.S. coast under the command of Captain Marko Ramius. The American government thinks Ramius is planning to attack. Lone CIA analyst Jack Ryan has a different idea: he thinks Ramius is planning to defect, but he has only a few hours to find him and prove it - because the entire Russian naval and air commands are trying to find Ramius, too. The hunt is on!
movies.title: The Hunt for Red October
movies.tagline: Invisible. Silent. Stolen.

movies.overview: Rex and Saskia, a young couple in love, are on vacation when they stop at a busy service station. Saskia is abducted in broad daylight and three years pass with no answers or closure surrounding her disappearance. Rex has nearly given up all hope when he suddenly begins receiving letters from her abductor.
movies.title: The Vanishing
movies.tagline: Who Has Seen This Woman?

movies.overview: After an accident, acclaimed novelist Paul Sheldon is rescued by a nurse who claims to be his biggest fan.  Her obsession takes a dark turn when she holds him captive in her remote Colorado home and forces him to write back to life the popular literary character he killed off.
movies.title: Misery
movies.tagline: Paul Sheldon used to write for a living. Now, he’s writing to stay alive.

movies.overview: The story of Captain Richard Francis Burton's and Lt. John Hanning Speke's expedition to find the source of the Nile river in the name of Queen Victoria's British Empire.
movies.title: Mountains of the Moon
movies.tagline: Two strangers made friends by a savage land. Two friends made enemies by the civilized world.

movies.overview: A young district attorney seeking to prove a case against a corrupt police detective encounters a former lover and her new protector, a crime boss who refuses to help him.
movies.title: Q & A
movies.tagline: When the questions are dangerous, the answers can be deadly.

movies.overview: Barley Scott Blair, a Lisbon-based editor of Russian literature who unexpectedly begins working for British intelligence, is commissioned to investigate the purposes of Dante, a dissident scientist trapped in the decaying Soviet Union that is crumbling under the new open-minded policies.
movies.title: The Russia House
movies.tagline: Their love was as dangerous as the secrets they kept.

movies.overview: In this luminous tale set in the former Yugoslavia, Perhan, an engaging young Romany with telekinetic powers, is seduced by the quick-cash world of petty crime that threatens to destroy him and those he loves.
movies.title: Time of the Gypsies

movies.overview: Renowned filmmaker John Wilson travels to Africa to direct a new movie, but constantly leaves to hunt elephants and other game, to the dismay of his cast and crew. He eventually becomes obsessed with hunting down and killing one specific elephant.
movies.title: White Hunter, Black Heart
movies.tagline: An adventure in obsession...

movies.overview: Dr. Peyton Westlake is on the verge of realizing a major breakthrough in synthetic skin when his laboratory is destroyed by gangsters. Having been burned beyond recognition and forever altered by an experimental medical procedure, Westlake becomes known as Darkman, assuming alternate identities in his quest for revenge and a new life with a former love.
movies.title: Darkman
movies.tagline: They destroyed everything he had, everything he was. Now, crime has a new enemy and justice has a new face.

movies.overview: Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, finds out that his uncle Claudius killed his father to obtain the throne, and plans revenge.
movies.title: Hamlet
movies.tagline: The extraordinary adaptation of Shakespeare's classic tale of vengeance and tragedy.

movies.overview: An American couple drift toward emptiness in postwar North Africa.
movies.title: The Sheltering Sky
movies.tagline: A woman's dangerous and erotic journey...

movies.overview: Mark Hunter, a lonely high school student, uses his shortwave radio to moonlight as the popular pirate DJ "Hard Harry." When his show gets blamed for a teen committing suicide, the students clash with high school faculty and the authorities.
movies.title: Pump Up the Volume
movies.tagline: TALK HARD. STEAL THE AIR.

movies.overview: A gallery of characters in Brooklyn in the 1950s are crushed by their surroundings and selves: a union strike leader discovers he is gay; a prostitute falls in love with one of her clients; a family cannot cope with the fact that their daughter is illegitimately pregnant.
movies.title: Last Exit to Brooklyn
movies.tagline: The Novel That Shocked The World Is Now A Movie

movies.overview: Construction worker Douglas Quaid's obsession with the planet Mars leads him to visit Recall, a company that manufactures memories. When his memory implant goes wrong, Doug can no longer be sure what is and isn't reality.
movies.title: Total Recall
movies.tagline: They stole his mind. Now, he wants it back.

movies.overview: Two women, black and white, in 1955 Montgomery Alabama, must decide what they are going to do in response to the famous bus boycott led by Martin Luther King.
movies.title: The Long Walk Home
movies.tagline: A story of an incredible friendship.
